pages.text: Offer one Clay Ball and one Wood Ash. Both small and medium circles must already be complete, using any mix of non-focal chalks. Hold the desired chalk in your offhand with at least 28 uses left.
Pay 300 starting power, or 255 with Hecate's Visage. Only the twenty-eight medium-ring glyphs are repainted; the small circle keeps its colors. There is no ongoing power cost or completion item.
